description: Search businesses by term, location, categories, and price with sorting and pagination.

term.description: Optional search term matched against business name and categories.

location.description: Optional location matched against city, state, or address.

categories.description: Optional comma-separated category aliases to filter by.

price.description: Optional comma-separated price levels ('$'..'$$$$' or 1..4) to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of businesses to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of businesses to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has total, businesses, and region; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single business by its id or alias.

business_id.description: The id or alias of the business.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the business object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
